releases.title: PoemWorld v0.1
releases.author: builder
releases.body:
PoemWorld v0.1: the assembled delivery (builder 8db1143 + writer src/poemworld/poemworld/instructions/ + the repo's dev tree), as `ht-role delivery` assembles it. It is the tree of the pull request, minus the CLAUDE.md symlink the pull request keeps from dev.

Install (trial machine, Python 3.12, Docker):
  mkdir hutian && tar xzf poemworld-delivery.tar.gz -C hutian && cd hutian
  python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install ./src/hutian ./src/poemworld
  .venv/bin/poemworld --version
Images (HUTIAN_COMMIT is any label, e.g. the release tag):
  v=$(.venv/bin/poemworld --version | cut -d' ' -f2); origin="--build-arg HUTIAN_VERSION=$v --build-arg HUTIAN_COMMIT=poem-v0.1"
  docker build $origin -f src/poemworld/Dockerfile -t poemworld:local .
  packages=poemworld-packages:$(cat src/hutian/hutian/execution/install_packages.py src/poemworld/worker.Dockerfile src/poemworld/poemworld/data/packages.json | sha256sum | cut -c1-12)
  docker build -f src/poemworld/worker.Dockerfile -t "$packages" .
  docker build $origin --build-arg "BASE=$packages" -f src/hutian/hutian/execution/Containerfile -t poemworld-worker:local .
Run: .venv/bin/poemworld config default > poem.json (set the worker agent/model as the task says), then
  .venv/bin/poemworld run --config poem.json --topic "Write a four-line poem about the first snow."
  .venv/bin/poemworld execute <pw-id> --loop
Checked here: pip install and `poemworld --version`, and both roles' instructions render. Not checked here: Docker builds and a world run (no Docker on the builder sandbox).
